fidelity: F2a — Fast-Spectrum Point Kinetics + Lumped Thermal + Breeding
description: Six-group delayed-neutron point kinetics for a FAST (sodium-cooled) spectrum coupled to a lumped fuel+sodium thermal model. Doppler + axial-expansion + sodium-void reactivity feedback (net-negative power coefficient). Breeding ratio > 1 (U-238 -> Pu-239). Stiff ODE (very small prompt-neutron generation time) — Radau/BDF.
source: Waltar & Reynolds (1981) Fast Breeder Reactors, Pergamon; Duderstadt & Hamilton (1976) Nuclear Reactor Analysis, Wiley; Keepin (1965) Physics of Nuclear Kinetics; Guidez & Prele (2017) Sodium Cooled Fast Reactors; IAEA (2012) TECDOC-1689 (BN-800 class)

unit.name: Generic 2100 MWth / 800 MWe Sodium-Cooled Fast Breeder Reactor (BN-800/ASTRID class)

eta_thermal.note: Net efficiency; sodium fast cycle drives ~500C steam Rankine -> ~39%

Lambda.note: Prompt-neutron generation time, FAST spectrum (~4.4e-7 s) — ~45x shorter than PWR (2e-5 s); Waltar & Reynolds (1981), Duderstadt & Hamilton (1976)

beta.note: Pu-239-dominated 6-group delayed-neutron fractions, total beta_eff = 0.00330 (~half of U-235's 0.0065); Keepin (1965), Waltar & Reynolds (1981) Table 6-2

alpha_doppler.note: Doppler coefficient (-1.2 pcm/K); U-238 resonance broadening in fast fuel — negative, prompt-acting; Waltar & Reynolds (1981) Ch. 6

alpha_axial.note: Axial fuel-expansion coefficient (-0.3 pcm/K); fuel column lengthens with T -> increased leakage -> negative

alpha_void.note: Sodium-void reactivity coefficient, POSITIVE in large LMFBR core centre (spectral hardening). Applied to pseudo-void fraction; kept small enough that net power coefficient (Doppler+axial+void) stays NEGATIVE for self-stabilisation

void_per_K.note: Coolant-density-driven pseudo-void fraction per K above reference (sodium thermal expansion / incipient voiding surrogate)

T_Na_ref.note: Reference coolant temperature for void model; <=0 means use equilibrium coolant temperature

T_inlet.note: Core sodium inlet temperature (~355 C, BN-800 class)

m_f_cp_f.note: Lumped fuel heat capacity (m_f * cp_f); metallic/oxide fast fuel

m_Na_cp_Na.note: Lumped sodium-coolant heat capacity (m_Na * cp_Na); cp_Na ~1270 J/kg/K (Foust 1972 / Waltar & Reynolds 1981 Na tables)

hA_fc.note: Fuel-to-sodium heat-transfer coefficient * area; high due to excellent liquid-metal heat transfer

W_cp_coolant.note: Coolant mass flow * specific heat (W * cp_Na); sets core delta-T ~150 K (628 K in -> ~783 K out, ~510 C outlet)

breeding_ratio.note: Nominal breeding ratio > 1 (BN-800 class ~1.2; core+blanket U-238->Pu-239 conversion); Waltar & Reynolds (1981) Ch. 7

breeding_ratio_T_coeff.note: Weak BR increase with fuel temperature (spectrum hardening raises Pu-239 eta)

fissile_burn_rate.note: Fissile (Pu-239) destruction rate at rated power (~0.92 kg/day ~ 2100 MWth); used for cumulative breeding inventory tracking

rho_ext.note: External reactivity insertion; keep < beta_eff (0.0033) to avoid prompt criticality
